notes.title: Update to V2.0
notes.notes:
Dear players,

I am thrilled to announce a major update for NUDOMATIC! Here's what I have prepared for you:

🌍 New Event Map Management:
Navigate through a completely redesigned map with even more intuitive and immersive event management!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44003354/94d98ef8936928e85fd78a24ff33d32cc988188b.gif

🎬 Animated Scenes:
I have added animated scenes that will bring U's adventures to life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44003354/026f8842a4be52a72558c60e6997a38a0ba3a2b7.gif

👤 3D Characters:
For the first time, some characters will appear in 3D in the gallery. 
Discover more realistic and detailed character models.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44003354/b45466e9e5dbe630683f7b6e83ca9ef39a36a95f.gif

This update is the result of hard work, and I hope you will enjoy it as much as I enjoyed creating it. I look forward to hearing your feedback and seeing how you explore these new features!

Thank you for your continued support and passion for NUDOMATIC. See you in the game to discover all these new features!

Best regards,

Ultrabend

notes.title: Update and Steam NeoFest
notes.notes:
ULTRACORP is pleased to announce that Nudomatic will be present at Steam Neo Fest, so this is a good opportunity to update the Nudomatic demo.

What's more, development is progressing very well, with a potential release date at the end of the year.

So if you don't know Nudomatic, go ahead and try out the demo, and if not, let yourself be tempted!

And don't forget to add it to your Wishlist!
